findings.title: The sector re-bless check can hide a gameplay change between checkpoints
findings.claim: The diff accepts arbitrary replay-frame hash changes, while the independent gameplay checks sample only every 60 ticks.
findings.evidence: plan L2182-L2188 permits every `.hash` difference; tests/golden.test.ts:L27-L37 checks pinned gameplay projections at 60-tick checkpoints; scripts/determinism/fixture.ts:L87-L89 also samples every 60 ticks.
findings.why: A sector state change that affects an intervening tick and reverses before the next checkpoint can change frame hashes while leaving the permitted diff, pinned projections, and fixture samples passing. The stated version-only proof therefore does not rule out a gameplay change.
findings.fix: Capture and compare version-independent canonical state after every replay tick before and after the bump. Reject any non-version difference before writing the re-blessed golden.

findings.title: The sector diff command is not executable in the supplied shell
findings.claim: Task 4 gives a Bash command without a shell invocation, but the checkout’s shell is Windows PowerShell 5.1.
findings.evidence: plan L2180-L2186 uses `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}` and `&&`; the supplied shell reports PowerShell 5.1.
findings.why: Those Bash constructs fail when the step is run verbatim in PowerShell, so the required version-only check cannot complete.
findings.fix: State an explicit Git Bash invocation for this step, or provide a PowerShell 5.1 command that writes the baseline JSON as UTF-8.

verified: All 17 TypeScript blocks presented as created or whole-file replacements compiled together in a read-only, in-memory overlay under the web project’s strict TypeScript options: zero diagnostics.

The consumed sim exports and signatures match the plan, including `predictPath`, `queryGrid`, `pursuitTurn`, `laserEligible`, `canLaunch`, and `stepDuelTick` (plan L979-L980; src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/predict.ts:L22; grid.ts:L24; hunter.ts:L20; weapons.ts:L36-L52; src/renderer/src/sim/duel/step.ts:L71).

The scripted release uses `laserEligible`, which includes range, arc, and line of sight; the telemetry arc deliberately omits line of sight as stated (plan L100-L104, L927-L929, L1311-L1312; src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/weapons.ts:L48-L52).

The gate tests cover seeds 1–10 with individual 60-second timeouts, both weapons per seed, the planet-contact threshold, the cap, median duration, and both outcomes (plan L1399-L1407, L1475-L1495; spec L104-L112).

The hull edit is the sole change in the pasted tactical tuning file. The two pinned readout rows are updated, and the H-1b readout derives its displayed maximum from `SHIP_HULL` (plan L1573-L1576, L1644-L1675; tests/duelReadout.test.ts:L25-L26; src/renderer/src/render/duel/readoutModel.ts:L48-L56).

The fixture re-bless compares all stored canonical sample fields except `$simVersion` and all stored boundaries before writing; its sampling limit is reflected in the first finding (plan L2154-L2165; scripts/determinism/protocol.ts:L3-L12).
not_verified: Jest/Vitest, bless, and the screenshot check were not run because this review is read-only and the user prohibited running the suite; the stated golden hashes and gate outcomes remain unverified by execution.
